maria: Quick alignment thread — NebulaRack offered an euw3 pilot but requires marketplace SKU + legal gate before we enable. Need capacity shape, network constraints, and a short dry-run.

alex: what's the pod spec and network egress limits?

maria: pod = 4x A100, initial 2 pods. Partner limits public egress to 5TB/mo per pod; private peering OK.

li-chen: proposing SKUs: `redwood.dedicated.euw3.small` (2-pod hourly) and `redwood.dedicated.euw3.medium` (4-pod reserved). Will draft PR when we have test creds + cert chain.

sam: legal needs: VSA, DPA (EU residency), ISO27001 attestation. No SOC2 — restrict to invited alpha customers and increase audit retention. Need docs by Thu EOD.

maria: i'll request test tenant + certs from natalie now. natalie: pls share test creds and cert chain.

natalie (nebularack): sending creds and certs to maria via secure share in 1h. HSM passthrough confirmed.

alex: draft dry-run steps: provision -> perf smoke (100 users, 10m) -> cache warm -> failover 10% -> billing events check.

li-chen: will add CI smoke job to marketplace PR.

maria: actions: maria get creds/docs; sam review legal; li-chen PR; alex runbook. launch-bot schedule dry-run once legal clears.

launch-bot: Dry-run placeholder requested. Awaiting legal sign-off.
